additional_info.subject: RE: 0455611 - ID0455611-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP/R7 170002201] CBL3 - Meter values 0 kWh CRM:00314000235
additional_info.body:
Dear Naim,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0455611
for charger
MP/R7 170002201
at Manor.
Around two weeks ago we investigated regarding 0kWh sessions, with clear signs in the logs of a known LEM error of random occurrence, which will be corrected in FW
v8.1.X
On 16.10 we performed a Hard reboot onsite of the charger, as well as a FW update to v8.0.5, and since then you monitored the charger and the 0kWh sessions never appeared anymore.
For this reason, we will proceed to close this ticket for the time being.  I recommend you to please update the charger to the newest FW version as soon as it is released, and to open a new ticket in case the issue will appear again.
Thank you again for the collaboration and support!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
